title: The Sample Threshold for Discovering Conservation Laws: A Spiked-Covariance Analysis, a Matching Lower Bound, and Its Limits on Real Pendulum Data

creators.name: Selvaraj, Jagadeesh
creators.affiliation: NextGen Technologies Private Limited, Chennai, India

description: In a Gaussian model with library size p, k conserved quantities and signal-to-noise ratios lambda_j on the other feature directions, the bottom-k sample eigenspace aligns with the true invariants if and only if A_2 = sum_j (1+1/lambda_j)^2 < n, a spiked-covariance transition with the spike below the bulk. The record contains the research monograph (full proofs, all tables), the journal-length article, and a replication folder (code, saved outputs, checksums). On real double- and triple-pendulum data the transition comes later than the formula predicts, and the paper measures and explains the gap. The threshold test rests on one apparatus.
notes: Monograph v33 (draft edition, November 2026); article dated 8 November 2026. The article is also submitted to a journal.
